Title: Generally Available: Reminder - End of Limited Time Promotional Discounts on Azure Databricks Serverless Compute Services

Body.Content:
The limited time discount for Azure Databricks Automated and Interactive Serverless Compute will end on April 30, 2025. Serverless compute provides rapid workload startup, automatic infrastructure scaling, and seamless version upgrades of the Azure Databricks runtime.  

Learn more.
